statement_map.email_excerpt: You wanted your customers to receive the order confirmation email after they buy, since you had already connected your payment gateway.
Following our guidance, you switched on the order confirmation email for your product and saved it, and the confirmation email from your test order arrived in your inbox.
We explained that the email still shows the default sender name and that you can change it under Email settings, Sender name.
Change the sender name to your brand name under Email settings, Sender name (after the call, as you mentioned).
